[[Flint's Fleshcleaver]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Flint Fleshcleaver]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Grenth's Footprint]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (20% chance)
:Halves casting time of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (20% chance)
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as an [[Accursed Staff]] colored a dark purple.
